name: Navardún (Spain)
description: Blue field with yellow stripes curving from the hoist corners to the fly and a red stripe across the centre widening into an oval bearing a yellow tower.
history: As set out in decree 305/2015 of the Government of Aragon signed in Zaragoza on 1 December 2015 and published in the Boletín Oficial de Aragón of 10 December 2015, the municipal flag of Navardún is a cloth of proportions 2:3, blue, with a yellow horizontal stripe from the upper and lower parts of the hoist to the fly; at the centre of the hoist two red horizontal stripes which widen into an oval at the centre, in which is set a yellow tower of six merlons with black door and windows, and which continue to the fly as a single stripe.
